sourceCopy.name: Word Puzzle Solver
sourceCopy.title: Word Finder & Anagram Solver Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Find anagrams and crossword-pattern words with letter filters. Use a small local word list or paste your own. Free, private and no sign-up.
sourceCopy.intro: Find words you can spell from letter tiles, solve anagrams, or match a crossword pattern. Use the compact built-in starter list or paste a larger word list; everything is searched in this tab.
sourceCopy.summary: A local word finder for anagrams, blank tiles, crossword-style letter patterns, word length and excluded-letter filters. It does not guess meanings from clues.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How does this word finder work?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Choose anagram mode to find words that can be made from your letters, or pattern mode to match fixed letters and ? or . placeholders. Results come only from the selected compact built-in list and/or the word list you paste.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Are my letters or word list uploaded?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. Searches run locally in this page. Your letters and pasted word list are not uploaded, saved to an account or sent to a server.

fields.lettersHint: Enter letters only. Use ? for a blank tile. Unless “use every tile” is checked, a result may use only some letters.
fields.patternHint: Enter known letters and use ? or . for each unknown position. Each placeholder matches one letter.
fields.wordListHint: Paste one word per line. Only these words are used in custom-only mode. Maximum 250,000 characters and 50,000 words.
fields.excludedHint: Any word containing one of these letters is removed.
fields.compactListNote: The included multilingual starter vocabulary is intentionally small, not a complete dictionary or official crossword/Scrabble word list. Paste a larger list when you need broad coverage.
fields.privacyNote: All processing stays in this browser tab. Pasted words are not stored after leaving the page.
fields.truncated: Showing the first {count} matches. Narrow your filters to see more specific results.
fields.noResults: No matching words were found in the selected list. Try another pattern, adjust the filters or paste a larger word list.
fields.emptySelection: Choose a search type and enter letters or a pattern.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I use blank tiles in an anagram?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Enter ? for each blank tile. Each ? can stand for one letter. “Use every letter tile” requires a match to use all entered tiles.

additionalFaqs.question: Can this solve a crossword clue by meaning?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It only matches letter patterns and filters words in the selected list; it does not understand clue meanings or provide semantic answers.

additionalFaqs.question: Does the built-in list contain every word?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. It is a small multilingual starter vocabulary, not a complete dictionary or official game-word list. Paste your own word list for broader coverage.
